name: purchase-order
title: DRAFT purchase order
for_each: select id,reference from orders where status in ('approved','closed') order by reference

sections.title: Order details
sections.note: Net amounts only. Add applicable tax and verify delivery details before issuing. This file has not been sent.

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select line_ref,description,quantity,unit_price,ordered_value from line_position where order_id=$1 order by line_ref

name: receipt-register
title: Goods receipt record
for_each: select id,reference from orders order by reference

sections.title: Recorded receipts
sections.sql: select r.reference,l.description,r.quantity,r.received_on,r.evidence_ref from receipts r join order_lines l on l.id=r.line_id where l.order_id=$1 order by r.received_on,r.reference

name: matching-report
title: DRAFT invoice matching report
for_each: select id,reference from orders order by reference

sections.title: Match position
sections.sql: select description,currency,quantity,received,invoiced,unit_price,invoice_value,price_variance,invoice_ahead_of_receipt from line_position where order_id=$1 order by line_ref
sections.note: A recorded match is not payment authorisation. Source documents, tax and supplier details need review.

sections.title: Evidence and retention
sections.sql: select i.reference,i.evidence_ref,i.tax_year_end,i.retain_until from invoices i join order_lines l on l.id=i.line_id where l.order_id=$1 order by i.reference
